# QCSunny Lab

> QCSunny Lab (https://qcsunny.org) is a personal developer technical blog and collection of 34+ free, browser-based online tools. All tools execute entirely client-side with zero tracking, offline capability, and zero data uploads.

## Online Tools

### Calculators
- [Scientific Calculator](https://qcsunny.org/calculators/standard/): Complete scientific calculator with operator precedence, trigonometric functions, memory, DEG/RAD modes.
- [Function Grapher](https://qcsunny.org/calculators/graph/): Interactive mathematical function plotting with multi-graph overlay, pan, and zoom.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://qcsunny.org/calculators/percentage/): Percent of value, percentage difference, and part-of-whole calculations.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://qcsunny.org/calculators/fraction/): Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions with step-by-step simplification.
- [Average & Statistics](https://qcsunny.org/calculators/average/): Mean, median, mode, variance, and standard deviation for dataset analysis.
- [Ratio & Proportion](https://qcsunny.org/calculators/ratio/): Ratio simplification, scale calculations, and direct/inverse proportions.

### Finance Helpers
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://qcsunny.org/finance/compound-interest/): Investment growth simulator with monthly deposits, compounding frequencies, and year-by-year amortization table.
- [Mortgage & Loan Calculator](https://qcsunny.org/finance/mortgage/): Home loan and personal loan monthly payment calculator with amortization schedule, interest breakdown, and property tax/insurance support.
- [Investment Return & ROI](https://qcsunny.org/finance/roi/): Return on investment (ROI), annualized ROI, and profit margin analysis.
- [Salary & Tax Calculator](https://qcsunny.org/finance/salary/): Gross-to-net salary converter with after-tax calculations.

### Converters
- [Length Converter](https://qcsunny.org/converters/length/): Meters, kilometers, feet, inches, miles, centimeters, and millimeters.
- [Weight Converter](https://qcsunny.org/converters/weight/): Kilograms, grams, pounds, ounces, and metric tons.
- [Temperature Converter](https://qcsunny.org/converters/temperature/): Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.
- [Data Storage Converter](https://qcsunny.org/converters/data/): Bits, Bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB (both decimal and binary / IEC mebibytes).
- [Area, Volume, Speed, Time](https://qcsunny.org/converters/): Full suite of physical unit conversion utilities.

### Developer Utilities
- [QR Code Generator](https://qcsunny.org/tools/qr-code-generator/): Offline QR code generator with selectable ECC levels (L/M/Q/H) and instant PNG download.
- [UUID Generator](https://qcsunny.org/tools/uuid-generator/): Cryptographically secure batch RFC4122 v4 UUID generator.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://qcsunny.org/tools/json-formatter/): Offline JSON beautifier, minifier, and error validator.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://qcsunny.org/tools/base64/): Text and binary base64 conversion.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://qcsunny.org/tools/word-counter/): Live text statistics: word count, character count, reading time, and CJK token count.
- [Color Converter](https://qcsunny.org/tools/color-converter/): Real-time HEX, RGB, HSL color conversion with complementary color swatch.

## Engineering Blog
- [Calendar Page & Date Algorithms](https://qcsunny.org/blog/calendar-page/): Pure date algorithms and ISO week number calculations in TypeScript.
- [Fullscreen Clock & Pomodoro](https://qcsunny.org/blog/clock-page/): Zero-dependency responsive clock and timer design.
- [GLM-5.3 vs Hy4 Preview MoE Comparison](https://qcsunny.org/blog/glm-5-3-vs-hy4-preview/): Detailed architectural and benchmark comparison of 78-layer MoE models.
- [Web Calculator & Browser Utilities Architecture](https://qcsunny.org/blog/web-calculator/): Designing 34 zero-dependency client-side tools.
